method: random fragments (>= 60 px) drawn in red over the scan crop next to the raw crop (scratch montages), judged by eye by the extractor: PASS = the whole fragment follows one real contour line; FAIL = it leaves the contour (tree glyph, fence, road, building, neatline)
caveat: one reviewer (the author of the extractor); no second reader; judged on the fragment geometry, not on its level
